description: Compact spherical density with peak 5.1σ; three protein donor atoms (ASP carboxylate + ATP O1G) within 2.1 Å. No plausible ligand fit.

expected_decision.rationale: Density shape and donor environment match a metal coordination site. Trigger ion search to enumerate metal templates from PDB homologs.

notes: Acceptable alternates: detect_ion_like_density (atomic primitive) as a precursor.
